dedupe_keys.name: hurricane ian storm surge modeling dataset wind forcing comparison and hydrodynamic simulations

description: Mithun Deb publishes wind-forcing comparisons and FVCOM hydrodynamic output for Hurricane Ian on the west Florida coast in 2022. Zenodo lists four public files under CC BY 4.0: three ZIP bundles and a NetCDF of maximum water elevation on an unstructured triangular mesh. The bundles describe NOAA-gauge wind errors across twelve historical hurricanes and several Ian forcing options, including ERA5, GAHM, CFSR and Holland fields. These inputs and outputs support sensitivity tests for coastal flooding, asset exposure and surge-model calibration. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Ian wind-forcing experiment; other Ian records in the catalogue concern building damage imagery or permits. Coverage is the named storms and the Florida FVCOM mesh, not every US coastline. Wind modifications are scenarios, not observations. No archive was downloaded, and neither wind errors nor maximum elevations were recalculated.
